Hello Vraja Dental Care team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for dental clinics in Chennai. I was looking at vrajadentalcare.com this week. Your sign board photo says it all, 'Since 1987', and your clinic photos show a calm, spotless place that patients would feel safe walking into.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:
A:
See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/vraja-dental-care/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. You start at your sign board, walk through the entrance and waiting room, and into your treatment rooms, with a short line on what you offer.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a dentist in Madipakkam”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now vrajadentalcare.com doesn't give these tools your business details in a form they can read, like most websites built a few years ago. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

What you get for ₹25,000 (one-time)

  • This new website, live on your own domain (vrajadentalcare.com)
  • Works smoothly on phones and computers
  • Ready for AI search: your treatments, timings, address, phone and answers to common questions, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can read and recommend you
  • A “book an appointment” button that sends the date straight to your WhatsApp
  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so patients searching for dentists in Madipakkam can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch
  • Free hosting: no monthly server bill
  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live

Timeline: live in 7 days

  • Day 1: a quick call, and we start
  • Days 2–3: you send any new photos or changes
  • Day 5: you see the updated version
  • Day 7: it goes live on vrajadentalcare.com
